name: Cadence Weapon
description: '''Roland''' "'''Rollie'''" '''Pemberton''' (born February 21, 1986), better known by his stage name '''Cadence Weapon''', is a Canadian [[rapper]] based in Toronto, Ontario. Born and raised in [[Edmonton]], Alberta, Pemberton released his first album, ''[[Breaking Kayfabe]]'', in 2005 with positive reviews. He subsequently signed with the American record label [[ANTI-]], releasing the albums ''[[Afterparty Babies]]'' in 2008 and ''[[Hope in Dirt City]]'' in 2012. In 2009, Cadence Weapon was named Edmonton's [[poet laureate|Poet Laureate]].
